failure_summary.description: The agent treated a new constraint as no-op or a proximity request instead of retrieving the suitable cached result and applying the hotel filter.
The agent asked for missing hotel dates but omitted the requested restaurant search, whose required inputs were available.
The agent used imports or prior-turn variables and omitted required result assignment and cache saving.

patch.reasoning: The observed failures are already directly covered by the skill: reconcile each domain against the conversation and cache, apply new same-domain constraints to suitable cached results, complete ready domains when another needs clarification, and retrieve and save tool results correctly. Additional edits would duplicate existing guidance rather than address a missing rule.
